items.summary: ## Features * Adds an option to group the "Profit and Loss Statement" and "Balance Sheet" reports by accounting dimension, so users can compare financial results across dimensions. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59377) * When _Use Transaction Date Exchange Rate_ is enabled, **Purchase Receipt** and **Purchase Invoice** documents mapped directly from a **Purchase Order** use the exchange rate for their posting date. Rates entered after mapping or carried over from another purchase document remain unchanged on later saves, and changing the posting date before the first save fetches the rate for the new date. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60181) * Allows users to submit a **Period Closing Voucher** when the stock account balance and stock value differ by up to 1%, after reviewing and confirming the difference; larger differences still block submission. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60193) * Updates ERPNext’s module dock with soft, single-color icons that adapt to light and dark themes and hover or active states, and gives CRM, Support, and Portal their own icons. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60325) * Adds a United States chart of accounts for new **Company** records with _Country_ set to United States, replacing the generic standard chart.
